title: Employee and Manager with inherited bonus
statement: Define an Employee class with a private attribute salary, a public Salary method that returns it, and a Bonus method that returns 10% of the salary. Define a Manager class that extends Employee and overrides Bonus to return 20% of the salary. Read the salary, create a Manager and write its bonus.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
The statement asks the salary to be a private attribute.
